About

Andrew Tanny Liem works at the intersection of teaching, research, and software development — with a focus on tools that reduce learning friction. Atlverse is the personal research-and-build space of Andrew Tanny Liem, where papers become prototypes, prototypes become tools, and tools return to real classrooms.
